items.item_text: High school diploma, General Equivalency Degree (GED), or High School Equivalency Diploma (HSED) or equivalent.
Event and Operational Support
Coordinate logistics for departmental events, including move-in, move-out, Bobcat Day, and other key Housing, Residence Education, and Auxiliary Facilities events, adjusting schedules as needed.
Manage space requests, room reservations, and meeting logistics for events, meetings, and special projects.
Coordinate meeting agendas and ensure required event documentation, including attendee lists and business justifications, is completed and submitted.

Arrange meals and refreshments (travel) and ensure compliance with university policies related to meetings, entertainment, travel, and special events, including Higher Approvals, Exceptions to policy and other requirements when applicable.
Provide support for additional events and special projects as assigned.

Coordinate professional and student staff recruitment activities in partnership with the Auxiliaries Enterprises Employment Coordinator and departmental leadership, including interview scheduling, hiring documentation, onboarding, and offboarding.

In coordination with the AFI Employment Coordinator, manage closely the logistics for the Professional Staff recruitment process and coordinate communication, travel, lodging, and interview logistics for candidates.

Facilitate the Resident Assistant recruitment process by collaborating with departmental leadership to assess staffing needs, coordinating with campus partners to streamline logistics, and overseeing all phases of the recruitment cycle from planning through selection.
Facilitate on-campus interview arrangements, including overnight accommodations when needed.
Prepare and distribute candidate communications, recruitment materials, and interview schedules.
Personnel Systems and Payroll Coordination
Enhanced hiring, onboarding, and offboarding documentation and processes working in step with the AFI Employment Coordinator.
Review and distribute UC Path and Cognos reports to departmental leadership and provide training on report utilization and compliance requirements.
Monitor payroll-related actions, coordinate issue resolution with campus partners, and maintain effective working relationships with Human Resources and Payroll.
Serve as a backup timesheet approver and departmental coordinator within the Time Reporting system.
Coordinate employee roster management and ensure data accuracy across personnel systems, including performance management platforms.
Financial Operations and Inventory Management
Manage departmental inventory processes, including asset tracking, transfers, audits, and surplus disposal.
Coordinate operational purchasing activities, purchase orders, and procurement requests in alignment with campus and AFI Finance procedures.

Administer and audit procurement and travel card programs, including access requests, training coordination, reconciliation support, compliance monitoring, and reporting. May entail delegate access and submitting requests on behalf of departmental staff occasionally.
Support departmental purchasers by providing guidance and coordinating procurement resources with the AFI Finance team.
Process invoices, recharges, purchase orders, and related financial documentation, serving as the primary contact for vendor payment inquiries.
Order equipment and office supplies and support financial tracking and reporting for departmental budgets.
Administrative Operations and Organizational Support
Develop and maintain processes for administrative support requests to ensure timely and effective service.
Perform and coordinate administrative functions for supported departments and provide backup support across AFI as needed.

Train staff on essential administrative processes to ensure continuity of operations and cross-functional support such as payroll action for student and staff personnel, review of staffing reports, submitting service tickets, auditing processes and more.
Serve as a member of the Auxiliaries Enterprises Administrative Team, providing coverage during absences, leaves, and peak workload periods.
Supervise and support student administrative staff as assigned.
Bachelor’s degree In business administration, hospitality management, or a related field. (Preferred)
